reason: A takes on my doubt about chain access directly: in those 14 counties, most people's nearest chain is more than 20 miles away. It also tells me two pharmacies will stop filling for our members and offers invoices and a meeting before May 1, all of which I can check. B has unfilled placeholders, makes looser claims like "go without their medicine," and adds a PBM disclosure demand that the facts don't support.
